description: Core data type definitions shared across all firmware modules. Includes test records, spectrophotometer readings, assay structures, and configuration types.

userStories.title: Define BrevitestTestRecord structure
userStories.description: Create the main test record structure (9668 bytes) that stores all test data including header info and spectrophotometer readings array.
acceptanceCriteria: All fields from legacy firmware preserved
userStories.documentation: Add Doxygen comments for all fields

userStories.title: Define BrevitestSpectrophotometerReading structure
userStories.description: Create the 32-byte spectrophotometer reading structure with all 10 AS7341 channels plus metadata.

userStories.title: Define BrevitestAssay structure
userStories.description: Create the assay structure that holds downloaded test instructions (BCODE).
userStories.notes: BCODE is the instruction set for running tests

userStories.title: Define EEPROM storage structure
userStories.description: Create persistent storage structure for firmware version, test counts, and running test recovery.
acceptanceCriteria: Running test UUID for crash recovery
Running assay ID for crash recovery
userStories.notes: Must be backwards compatible with existing EEPROM data

userStories.title: Define enumeration types
userStories.description: Create all enum types used throughout firmware: DeviceMode, TestState, CartridgeState, BarcodeType, etc.
acceptanceCriteria: ErrorCode enum with all error conditions
userStories.notes: Values must match legacy firmware for state compatibility

userStories.title: Implement serialization utilities
userStories.description: Create helper functions for converting structures to/from byte arrays for transmission and storage.
userStories.notes: Must produce identical output to legacy firmware
